subprograms and other parts of the work.

In determining whether a product is a consumer product, doubtful cases shall be resolved in favor of coverage.  For a particular product received by a particular user, "normally used" refers to a typical or common use of that class of product, regardless of the status of the particular user or of the way in which the particular user actually uses, or expects or is expected to use, the product.  A product is a consumer product regardless of whether the product has substantial commercial, industrial or non-consumer uses, unless such uses represent the only significant mode of use of the product.

rows.old_en:
1. Create a Hugging Face account and sign in.
2. Open the pyannote model page, complete its access form and accept the terms.
3. In Settings → Access Tokens, create a new read-only token (Read).
4. Copy it into the installer and check access.
rows.old_pl:
1. Załóż konto Hugging Face i zaloguj się.
2. Otwórz stronę modelu pyannote, wypełnij formularz dostępu i zaakceptuj warunki.
3. W Settings → Access Tokens utwórz nowy token tylko do odczytu (Read).
4. Wklej go do instalatora i sprawdź dostęp.
rows.en:
